name: IRR: the intuitive physics engine's worst-case time irreversibility as a CBF on the policy's action, closed loop (dev)
registered: 2026-10-25 23:32 EDT (commit 74f5669), before any dev episode; after one smoke episode (ep 15000, tag _irrsmoke, which only checked that the code runs: 9 interventions, all certified, 0-7 mm edits, 3 s per decision, 25 s per fix; that episode timed out where the policy alone succeeded)
condition: runs only if CF3 passes (results/jenga/cf3_result.json GATE_CF3_pass); otherwise cancelled and reported.
filter: eval/irr_rollout.py: the fork CBF of eval/cbf_filter.py with its barrier replaced by h(p) = -max_j r_j(p), r_j = CF2 / CF3's reversal residual (64 futures, model_OIL, 2x errors, outside p's hand path); safe set h >= -1.3356 (fixed, label-free, as CF3). Trigger: the policy's plan violates it. Fix: G-CEM (eval/opt3.py, unchanged: 3 x 16 candidates on 32 search draws, 4 finals certified on 64 fresh draws), the cheapest certified transformation of this chunk; none certified -> hold (always certified: r = 0 exactly). Certificate on model_OIL only. Gripper = the policy's.

arms.irg: G-CEM fix: speed, pause, amplitude, back-off of this chunk
arms.irs: G-steer fix: irg + a 3-D offset (+-6 mm) ramped in, so the fix can reshape the approach (liveness)

episodes: the LF3 dev protocol: episodes 15000-15099, paired with paired_record_lflsfdev (policy alone), 2x execution noise, HARD_OFF, PER_EPISODE_SEEDS, local RTX 3090, 6 shards, tag _irrdev; after the LF5 and LF6 dev arms (never two GPU pools at once).
outcomes: replay-audited (eval/outcome_audit.py): neighbour topples, v4 and v4b success, time-outs, red falls before / after extraction; interventions per episode, fix kinds, edit size, seconds per fix.
selection: the LSF dev rule: fewest audited neighbour topples among arms with v4 >= policy - 5 pp; ties -> fewer interventions per episode (eval/irr_dev.py -> results/jenga/irr_dev.json). Dev only (exploratory): the selected arm then goes to a separately pre-registered fresh-episode head-to-head vs labelled LSF stage 2 (lsfa030) and psel (cbfps3m), alongside any selected lflsf arm.
scope: task-agnostic (latent patches + the robot's own hand path), label-free barrier and threshold (labels grade only), no reference to the first frame (background motion common to both branches cancels), off-the-shelf DINOv2 latent model_OIL; the fork / intuitive physics engine is the barrier, optimisation (G-CEM) is the filter.
amendment_1: 2026-10-26 00:21 EDT, after CF3 PASS and before any IRR dev episode (one smoke episode of the new arm, ep 15000, tag _irrsmoke, only to check it runs: 7 chunks gated, 24 edits, 2 min per episode, timed out): adds arm lfci000 = LF4's selected lfc000 (label-free value value_lf_alea.pt, eps 0.00, gradient edit of the policy's xyz under the latent CBF condition, gamma 0.5, every model step) acting ONLY in chunks whose plan the irreversibility barrier flags (r_max > 1.3356, once per chunk, eval/irr_rollout.py setup_gated); other chunks run the policy's commands. Motivation: lfc000's 21 time-outs are stalls at the grasp (never lifted, 50-100 edits), where the label-free value is low; the barrier flags 2.2% of safe grasping decisions (CF3). Same episodes, shards and outcomes; selection over irg, irs, lfci000 by the same rule. lfc000 itself (LF4 dev) is reported alongside.
